title: The Living World
subtitle: Entity themed update, with 8 new procedure blocks, triggers, and bug fixes!

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Make pet [ entity ] [SIT/STAND]
new_blocks.description: Makes the selected pet sit or stand.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Make [ source entity ] BackStab entity [ entity ] with offset x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Teleports the source entity behind the target entity using the specified positional offset, making it useful for backstab-style attacks.

new_blocks.name: Shake player [ entity ] camera with power [ x ] for [ x ] seconds
new_blocks.description: Shakes the selected player's camera with the specified intensity for the given duration.

new_blocks.name: Use blackhole at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] pull blocks in stacks [ x ] in radius [ x ] pull entities [ true/false ] in radius [ x ] with power [ x ] kill entities [ true/false ] active [ true/false ]
new_blocks.description: Creates and configures a black hole at the specified coordinates to pull or destroy nearby blocks and entities based on custom radius, power, and toggle settings.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Change Mob details [ Change age / Change size ] to [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Makes selected mob adult/baby or change mob's size.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Loop through all blocks tagged as [ tag ] in radius [ x ] use position x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] use block [ iterator ]
new_blocks.description: Loops through all blocks with the specified tag within the given radius, starting from the nearest block.

new_blocks.name: Get [ Nearest / Furthest ] Block [ Block ] in distance [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Returns the position vector of the nearest or furthest matching block within the specified distance.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Run only after [ x ] [Ticks / Seconds] { }
new_blocks.description: Delays the execution of the blocks inside until the specified time has passed. Calls made before the delay finishes are ignored.

new_triggers.name: When inventory cursor changes
new_triggers.description: Triggers whenever the item held on the player's mouse cursor changes while picking up, placing, or moving items inside an inventory.

changes.name: (REWORK) Is [ x ] [ IsFrozen / Brainless / HasImmunity / HasCustomTask ... ]
changes.description: Checks the current AI state of the entity, such as whether it is frozen or brainless. Added new stuff such as if entity is climbing.

fixes: Pathfinding: Fixed the 'attempt to make a path to closest block', 'block exists in the radius x' and 'Get non-air y block at xz' block so that you can now also use e.g. 'Get block at xyz'.
Skipping: Fixed 'Is entity AI state' where it doesn't check everything (only checked few things but ignored some things)
Java: There was still hard-coded stuff and now should no longer have those.
Java: Inventory ArrayList variable had few problems with 1.21.1 versions. Now should been fixed!

title: World Star
subtitle: 1.3.0 is here, the Largest Update! 3 new MCreator versions 20 new blocks, new triggers, and more!

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) [ x ] [ ++/-- ]
new_blocks.description: Increases/decreases by one.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) [ x ] [ +=/-= ] [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Increases/decreases by the amount of x.

new_blocks.name: Distance between x1: [ x ] y1: [ x ] z1: [ x ] and x2: [ x ] y2: [ x ] z2: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Returns the distance between two coordinates.

new_blocks.name: Every [ x ] call do { }
new_blocks.description: Executes the code inside after every x ticks. Works on the server-side only.

new_blocks.name: Cause [ x ] damage to the block at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] drop [ true/false ] recover after [ x ] seconds
new_blocks.description: Causes visual damage to the target block. You can also specify whether it drops items and how long it takes to revert back to normal.

new_blocks.name: Modify block at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] with teleport ability: [ true/false ] trigger offset Y: [ x ] sound: [ x ] particle: [ x ] seconds: [ x ] to dimension: [ x ] x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Adds a teleport ability to the target block. You can choose a Y-axis offset where the player must stand to activate the teleportation. The teleport works both within the same dimension and across different dimensions. WARNING! Carelessly adding blocks with teleport abilities can leave them behind in the world because they are not visible. Make sure you know exactly where you place them.

new_blocks.name: Get [ strongest/weakest ] redstone signal power at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Returns the strongest/weakest redstone signal that the target block receives.

new_blocks.name: Override movement of [ entity ] and move towards x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] with fly ability [ true/false ] mode [ LINEAR / SINE IN / SINE OUT / SINE IN OUT ] and speed [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Forces the entity to move/fly to the target coordinates using the desired interpolation style and speed.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Get [ PROFESSION / LEVEL_NUM / LEVEL_NAME ] of villager [ entity ]
new_blocks.description: Returns the target villager's profession, level name, or level number as a string. Returns empty if the entity is not a villager.

new_blocks.name: Push target entity [ entity ] in direction source entity [ source ] is facing with power [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Pushes the target entity with the desired power in the direction that the source entity is facing.

new_blocks.name: [ Pull/Push ] all entities in radius [ x ] target entity [ entity ] with power [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Pushes/pulls all entities within the desired radius toward the target entity with the desired power.

new_blocks.name: [ Pull/Push ] all entities in radius [ x ] position x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] with power [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Pushes/pulls all entities within the desired radius toward the target coordinate with the desired power.

new_blocks.name: Swap position between [ entity ] and [ source ]
new_blocks.description: Swaps the positions of the target entity and the source entity.

new_blocks.name: spin entity [ entity ] around position x [ x ] y [ x ] z [ x ] speed [ x ] radius [ x ] angle [ x ] dynamic rotation speed [ x ] stop condition [ NONE / TAKES DAMAGE / TARGET CHANGES ]
new_blocks.description: Spins the entity around the target block using the desired parameters and chosen stop condition.

new_blocks.name: Raycast gives entity [ x ] in range [ x ] towards direction of [ entity ]
new_blocks.description: Returns true/false depending on whether the desired entity is in the line of sight of the look-target entity.

new_blocks.name: Raycast gives block [ block ] in range [ x ] towards direction of [ entity ]
new_blocks.description: Returns true/false depending on whether the desired block is in the line of sight of the look-target entity.

new_blocks.name: Create structure map for structure [ x ] in slot [ x ] of [ entity ]
new_blocks.description: Creates a custom map in the entity's inventory, provided the entity has an inventory.

new_blocks.name: Set structure map with structure [ x ] in main hand of [ entity ]
new_blocks.description: Creates a custom map in the entity's main hand, if they have one.

new_blocks.name: Set structure map with structure [ x ] in off hand of [ entity ]
new_blocks.description: Creates a custom map in the entity's off hand (left hand), if they have one.

new_blocks.name: Set structure map with structure [ x ] in slot [ x ] of block at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] (if has inventory)
new_blocks.description: Creates a custom map in the block's inventory, provided the block has an inventory.

new_triggers.name: Projectile impacts (hits block or entity)
new_triggers.description: Activates when a projectile hits something. Returns [event/target entity] if it hits an entity, otherwise it returns only the coordinates of the impact.

new_triggers.name: Entity teleports using Ender Pearl
new_triggers.description: Activates when an entity uses an ender pearl. (Also activates when changing dimensions, as Minecraft counts that as an ender pearl teleport).

changes.old_name: Clear current attack/block target of [ x ]
changes.name: (REWORK) Cancel all custom tasks of [ x ]
changes.description: Creates a visual explosion by launching nearby blocks with physics. Gravity can be enabled or disabled. Now also includes a customizable option to ignore specific blocks.

changes.name: (REWORK) Attempt to make a path for [ x ] to locate the closest block [ x ] MODE [ x ]
changes.description: Forces the entity to ignore its current path and navigate to the nearest matching block within a 40-block search radius. Now this only requires to be called once.

fixes: Procedure: Fixed an issue where the 'Attempt to make a path for [ x ] to locate the closest block [ x ] MODE [ x ]' block was not working correctly.

title: Hotfix 1.2.1
subtitle: Fixed hard-coded java files that caused issues with the plugin.
fixes: Java classes: Fixed hard-coded mod ID on java classes (used my test modid instead of your own modid)

title: 2025.3 Update
subtitle: 2025.3 support, new procedure blocks and bug fixes!

new_blocks.name: Spawn Custom Fireball with texture [ x ] speed [ x ] inaccuracy [ x ] size [ x ] destroy MODE [ x ] fire MODE [ x ] enable fire [ x ] use trail particle [ x ] use gravity [ x ] shooter [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Spawns a custom fireball from an entity with the specified texture, speed, inaccuracy, explosion size, fire duration, fire visual toggle, trail particle, and gravity settings.

new_blocks.name: Spawn Custom Fireball from x [ x ] y [ x ] z [ x ] to x [ x ] y [ x ] z [ x ] with texture [ x ] speed [ x ] inaccuracy [ x ] size [ x ] destroy MODE [ x ] fire MODE [ x ] enable fire [ x ] use trail particle [ x ] use gravity [ x ] shooter [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Spawns a custom fireball from an entity or target point to the specified target coordinates with the selected texture, speed, inaccuracy, explosion size, fire duration, fire visual toggle, trail particle, and gravity settings.

new_blocks.name: Spawn Custom Eye with texture [ x ] ambient particles [ x ] break particles [ x ] break chance (0-1) [ x ] chase structure [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Spawns a custom Eye of Ender with custom textures and particles, and assigns its target direction/structure.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Save [ x ] inventory: Include Hotbar [ x ] Main Inventory [ x ] Armor [ x ] Offhand [ x ] into list [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Saves the specified entity's inventory slots into an InventoryArrayList variable.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) For each item in list [ x ] category [ x ] include empty [ x ] item: [ x ] slot: [ x ] count: [ x ] do [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Iterates through all saved slots of an entity stored in an InventoryArrayList variable.

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Make [ x ] attempt to find structure [ x ] with speed [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Forces the entity to pathfind to the specified structure and stops once reached. (Does not require a tick update).

new_blocks.name: (Suggestion) Make [ x ] semi-aquatic with swim speed [ x ] (Tick update required)
new_blocks.description: Converts the target entity into a semi-aquatic/Drowned-type mob capable of living underwater. (Tick update required).

new_variables.name: InventoryArrayList
new_variables.description: Stores an entity's inventory, hotbar, armor, and/or offhand slots within a single variable

fixes: Pathfinding: Fixed the 'attempt to make a path to closest block' block so that the entity now attempts to reach the exact target block directly, rather than settling for an adjacent block.
Variable Conversions: Fixed several issue with x, y, z variables ('cannot convert object to double').
Fill Portal: Fixed an issue where the 'Fill portal' procedure block created multiple duplicate portal planes

title: Update 2026.2
subtitle: 2026.2 support, new procedure blocks, reworked block and bug fixes!

new_blocks.name: If Portal of type [ x ] meets requirements: MinWidth [ x ] MinHeight [ x ] MaxWidth [ x ] MaxHeight [ x ] and Block of type [ x ] with Blockstate (-1 to ignore) [ x ] use block at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Checks if a custom portal meets the shape and size requirements.

new_blocks.name: Fill Portal of type [ x ] using Block of type [ x ] use block at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Fills the frame opening of a custom portal with the specified block.

new_blocks.name: Get free slot number from [ x ] [ x ] return 999 if no slots available
new_blocks.description: Returns the first empty slot number from the hotbar or inventory. Returns 999 if no empty slots are found.

new_blocks.name: Get highest/lowest block y-value for [ x ] at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] start from y: [ x ] [ x ] return 999 if no result
new_blocks.description: Checks the Y-coordinate of an open/air block at the specified location and returns its Y-level. Returns 999 if no suitable block is found within the specified range.

changes.name: (REWORK) Launch nearby blocks at x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] with radius [ x ] power [ x ] gravity [ x ]
changes.description: Creates a visual explosion by launching nearby blocks with physics. Gravity can be enabled or disabled. Now also includes a customizable option to ignore specific blocks.

fixes: Fixed hardcoded instances that contained the plugin's test workspace mod ID. It now correctly uses each project's own mod ID.
Fixed a couple of issues where converting coordinates from an object type to a double type would cause certain parts of the procedure blocks to stop functioning.

title: Initial Release
